name: Flutter Browser
tagline: A full-featured web browser for your phone or desktop
description:
Flutter Browser is a full-featured web browser for your phone, with support for tabs, bookmarks, and all the everyday browsing features you'd expect. It's built to feel like a proper alternative to the big-name mobile browsers.

The same codebase also powers desktop versions, so the app you use on your phone works the same way on your computer.
